{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
There were many '''universities''' located throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Most taught the liberal arts of a society's particulars. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] the universities of [[Yelsain/Legends|Yelsain]] were considered to be the best in the the galaxy.

{{Edu-stub}}

==History==
[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Melvosh Bloor]] researched Investigative Politico-Sociology at [[Beshka University]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
